name: MKT_IMP_JOBS
description: This table stores information about the import jobs being kicked off by the user. It contains the header level details for the import process for example the import job name, object being imported, scheduling information, file information etc.

columns.name: IMPORT_JOB_ID
columns.description: Primary key

columns.name: SIMPL_IMPORT_JOB_FLAG
columns.description: Flag used to distinguish between classic and simplified import jobs

columns.name: UI_JOB_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Contains new File Import Status values

columns.name: MASS_UPDATE_DTL_ID
columns.description: Mass Update Detail Id for Import Job

columns.name: JOB_PARAMETERS
columns.description: To hold job parameters

columns.name: UCM_FILE_NAME
columns.description: To hold the fusion file name.

columns.name: IMPORT_JOB_NUMBER
columns.description: Alternate key for Import Jobs

columns.name: CDM_BATCH_ID
columns.description: CDM Batch Id

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Import job name

columns.name: DESC_TEXT
columns.description: Job description

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Import object type (lead, response, account, contact, prospect)

columns.name: FILE_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Source file type (text file, xml file)

columns.name: FILE_FORMAT_CD
columns.description: File format (comma separated, tab delimited, other delimiter, fixed width, xml)

columns.name: FILE_SELECTION_CD
columns.description: File selection (use exact file name, use most recent file)

columns.name: IMPORT_MODE_CD
columns.description: Import mode (import new records, update existing records)

columns.name: MATCH_RESOLUTION_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Match Resolution Guideline (create additional records, overwrite existing records, reject import record)

columns.name: ERROR_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Max number of errors allowed for the import job

columns.name: DELIMITER
columns.description: File delimiter

columns.name: HEADER_ROW_INCLUDED
columns.description: Indicates whether the header row will be included

columns.name: ENABLE_TURBO_IMPORT
columns.description: Indicates whether an Import job supports TURBO import for Base Table Upload

columns.name: NUM_LEAD_DUP_DAYS
columns.description: Duplicate lead lookback range in number of days

columns.name: FILE_NAME
columns.description: Full path of network-shared file

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate whether the task is active

columns.name: SCHEDULE_MODE_CD
columns.description: Schedule mode - repeating, one time(manually started), one time(scheduled)

columns.name: SCHEDULE_STATUS_CD
columns.description: Schedule status (scheduled, not scheduled, running, complete, error)

columns.name: START_TM
columns.description: Start date for schedule

columns.name: NEXT_SCHEDULE_TM
columns.description: Next scheduled date

columns.name: REPEAT_FREQUENCY
columns.description: Number of repeat frequency

columns.name: END_DATE_TM
columns.description: Repeat end date

columns.name: REPEAT_UNIT_CD
columns.description: Repeat unit code (hours, days, weeks, months)

columns.name: CALL_LST_ID
columns.description: Identifies theList for storing records

columns.name: IMPORT_FILE_ID
columns.description: Reference to the current file being imported

columns.name: IMPORT_MAP_ID
columns.description: Identifies the Import Mapping used for field mappings

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Email address for notification of job completion

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_FLAG
columns.description: Enable email notification (Y or N)

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PARENT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Parent Scheduler Request in case of Repeating Stages

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FILE_ENCODING_CODE
columns.description: File encoding code

columns.name: TIMESTAMP_FORMAT
columns.description: Timestamp format

columns.name: DATE_FORMAT
columns.description: Date format

columns.name: DECIMAL_SEPARATOR
columns.description: Decimal separator

columns.name: SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: System Task Id

columns.name: CONTENT_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Full path of network-shared attached document

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: Seeded Flag to indicate whether the job is a seeded job or not

columns.name: VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Visible Flag to indicate whether the job is going to be visible in the jobs listing page.

columns.name: CONTENT_DOC_ID
columns.description: Content Doc Id is to hold the internal document id from the UCM when the file is download or upload from UCM

columns.name: FILE_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: File Data Source to hold the source of the file. Example - Desktop, Network, URL, UCM etc

columns.name: NEXT_SCHEDULED_TIME
columns.description: Next Scheduled Time is going to hold the date and time of the next run of the job when the job is recurring type.

columns.name: ATTCH_CONTENT_DOC_ID
columns.description: Attachement Content Document Id to store the doument id of the attachemnts used in the file import.

columns.name: ATTCH_CONTENT_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Attachemnt Content File Name to hold the name of the attachment file name for the job, which is uploaded to the UCM.

columns.name: MAP_AUTOMATICALLY
columns.description: Column can have the values Y or N. The column value will be used to indicate whether a map was created automatically or not during the file import activity.

columns.name: OBJECT_DETAIL_NAME
columns.description: This column holds File Import Object Name

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: IMPORT_TYPE
columns.description: Import type specifies the type of import job, whether it is Simplified, standard, Optimized or classic.

columns.name: JOB_TYPE
columns.description: This column indicates if its job or template

columns.name: OBJECT_PARENT_LIC
columns.description: Comma separated list of 'LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE' values used to identify potential parent of object of a current object. Will be used for hierarchical display purpose

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: These will be used for defining the security predicates. Possible values could be: StandardObject, StandardChild, CustomChildOfStandard, CustomObject, CustomChildOfCustom, IntersectionObject.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
